articles.title: Dropbox acquires Tigris Data for $350M to bolster its AI infrastructure
articles.description: The deal is expected to support the development of DBX Agent Cloud, a new storage platform aimed at developers building AI models and agents.

articles.title: Aina’s smart ring has a screen, a joystick and a mic so you can talk to AI agents
articles.description: Aina's ring can also take calls and help you dictate notes on your Mac.

articles.title: Box taps Nvidia’s Nemotron for new agent-first content retrieval system
articles.description: The system can supposedly answer queries four times faster, with 20% fewer errors and 90% fewer tokens used.

articles.title: A YC startup is putting $1M behind five unsolved materials science problems for AI
articles.description: Discovered Materials, a months-old YC startup that uses AI to find chip materials, is offering $200,000 for each solution to five open materials science problems.

articles.title: Agility is the first pure humanoid robot company on the stock market. Are you buying?
articles.description: Agility arrives on the Nasdaq today as the first publicly-traded pure-play humanoid robotics company.

articles.title: 「世界最高水準」の性能うたう翻訳LLMをオープン化、PFN 0.8?31Bの4サイズ オンデバイスにも対応
articles.description: Preferred Networksは、翻訳特化型LLM「PLaMo 3 Translate」をオープンウェイトで公開した。

articles.title: フジテレビ、全ドラマでAI活用できる体制へ 2027年10月めど 「救命病棟２４時」で先行導入
articles.description: フジテレビジョンは、2027年10月をめどに、同社が制作する全ドラマでAIを活用できる体制を整えると発表した。

articles.title: Setting a new standard for responsible AI infrastructure
articles.description: OpenAI introduces its National Community Compact and Compute Campus Policy Blueprint to protect local resources, create jobs, and guide responsible AI infrastructure development.

articles.title: OpenAI、「Images 2.6」発表 生成速度50％向上、GIFアニメの生成も可能に
articles.description: OpenAIは、画像生成AIの新版「ChatGPT Images 2.6」を発表した。画像生成速度の向上や編集精度の改善に加え、新たにGIFアニメーション作成機能や、保存した写真を別チャットで再利用できる機能を追加した。開発者向けには2種類のAPIモデルを提供し、電子透かし技術の導入など安全対策も強化している。

articles.title: Apple is reportedly cutting budgets for its internal AI usage
articles.description: The company is said to be significantly dropping the amount it's spending on AI for its engineering teams.

articles.title: After the midterms, a bigger clash over data centers could be coming
articles.description: Data center opposition crossed party lines in Tuesday’s midterms.
